titulo: Why have your own Jarvis, and why make it safe
lead: Before trusting AI with your files, see what it can do and when it asks for your OK. One mistake or malicious text hidden on a website can lead AI to delete a folder or send a password somewhere else. Tested on Linux (Ubuntu). macOS: supported in the code, not tested live. Windows: only through WSL (Ubuntu inside Windows), not tested.
objetivo: Explain the eight parts of INTELECTO v2 and identify what’s allowed, needs approval, and is blocked in the demo.

aprende.t: Tell the assistant apart from the project box

hero_alt: The owner holds the key and keeps a humanoid assistant from touching a locked folder: the decision is human.

secoes.sub: Click a part; the cycle starts with you and ends with a log.

nos.detalhe: This is where you talk to it. Telegram accepts only the IDs (account numbers) of configured owners.
The assistant checks the brain, uses tools, and stops after up to five rounds.
SOUL, AGENTS, USER, and MEMORY set its style, rules, owner details, and initial facts.
Ollama runs AI on your computer. OpenRouter is a paid cloud service; it’s in the code, but INEMA hasn’t tested it live.
Memory is a local database: it stores facts and searches for words later, even without accent marks.
Read, write, list, and run commands; files are limited to the work folder.
Only read actions run; other actions require approval; known destructive actions are refused. Secrets are encrypted.
Optionally, each command runs in a Docker container: an isolated sandbox with the working folder and no network access.

secoes.legenda: The agent sandbox is another layer: it protects a copy of a project while a coding agent works on it.

secoes.sub: From the terminal or phone to the reply, in six steps from the project guide.

texto: The message arrives through the terminal or Telegram. On Telegram, the bot checks whether the ID belongs to the owners list; other senders are ignored and logged.
A request that starts with “remember that,” “save this,” or “make a note” is saved directly, without waiting for AI to call a tool. A question with ? doesn’t become a memory.
The assistant brings together identity files, memories related to the question, and recent conversations.
The local or cloud AI receives this context. It replies or asks for a tool, such as searching memory, reading a file, or running a command.
The requested command goes through the lock: it runs, asks for your OK, or is refused. If approved, it runs in the workspace or sandbox, when enabled; the result goes back to the AI.
You get the reply. Commands, tools, direct memories, and errors are recorded in the audit log for review.

secoes.sub: Click each step to see what to do.

texto: On Linux (Ubuntu), install Python 3.10+ and git. On macOS, install the command line tools with xcode-select --install; get Python 3.10+ from python.org or with brew install python. On Windows, use WSL with Ubuntu. Check the versions before continuing. If python3 --version shows a version below 3.10, use Ubuntu 22.04 or later before continuing.
Download INTELECTO, go into the folder, and run demo. The demo uses a simulated brain and shows memory, an allowed read, a refused write, and a blocked command.
The simulated brain saves “my name is Ana and I live in Curitiba” and answers the next question. This tests the mechanism; in lesson 3, you’ll test it with Ollama.
“ls” runs. “echo teste > nota.txt” asks for approval and is refused in the demo. “rm -rf /” is blocked.
The request to read ../../etc/passwd gets “fora da pasta de trabalho” (outside the working folder).

secoes.titulo: Run it without installing a model
secoes.sub: On macOS, you can also get Python 3.10+ from python.org; use brew install python only if you have Homebrew. Run the commands for your system, then download the project.

blocos.conteudo:
sudo apt install -y git python3 curl
python3 --version && git --version

blocos.rot: macOS · install terminal tools and git
Terminal · download the project and go into the folder
blocos.conteudo: cd ~ && git clone https://github.com/inematds/intelecto-v2 && cd intelecto-v2

abas.html:
livre     rodou=True  ls
aprovar   rodou=False echo teste > nota.txt
bloqueado rodou=False rm -rf /

secoes.sub: Follow the steps in order and check each one only after you’ve confirmed the result.

exercicios.texto: Run the demo and read the final “Audit of this demo” block.
exercicios.pronto: The lines livre, aprovar, and bloqueado appear, with rodou=True only for ls.

exercicios.texto: Say this out loud: the executor box (the program that runs the command) isolates one INTELECTO command; caixa-do-agente isolates a project copy for a coding agent.
exercicios.pronto: You can point out which one protects the command and which one protects the project.

secoes.sub: Choose before opening the explanation. If you get it wrong, use the link to review.

perguntas.p: Which part saves facts for another conversation?
perguntas.explica: Memory saves and searches for facts. The channel only receives the message; the box isolates the command.

perguntas.p: What happens to “rm -rf /” in the demo?
perguntas.explica: The guard classifies the destructive target as blocked, even if someone wants to approve it.

opcoes: Work on a copy of the project
Reply to messages in the terminal
perguntas.explica: The kit copies the project without secrets and shows the differences in a patch, a file that stores changes.

itens.texto: The demo works without a network or model.
The guard decides on actions; the box limits the command’s reach.
